identity.title: [v0.92.1][Runtime][Observatory][bug] Restore complete conversation transcripts from Runtime history

values.goal: Make Runtime-owned conversation history the authoritative reload source for complete ordered operator and agent transcripts.
values.required_outcome: An isolated conversation can submit operator text, receive an agent reply, discard client state, and restore both halves exactly once from bounded authorized conversation_history.v1 data.
declared_scope: operator outbound and agent reply persistence
authorization redaction pagination replay and deduplication bounds
authority_boundary: ingress.completed remains completion telemetry rather than the sole history source
operator_constraints: Test the production history and restoration flow end to end until it passes
Use isolated fixtures or server state
